findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms mean you will wait three months to receive your money, creating a significant cash flow burden for your business.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30 from the date of invoice.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to request one small change before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause (Invoices are payable Net 90.), waiting three months to receive payment creates a significant cash flow burden, so I propose changing it to: Invoices are payable Net 30 from the date of invoice. Let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
